limitations: Exploratory results; test year was viewed in EDA
Clusters are algorithmic partitions, not confirmed weather classes
Silhouettes in different representation spaces are not directly comparable superiority scores
Fixed 48h windows, one location and three encoder seeds
Month labels refer to window start; windows may span months
No causal attribution, anomaly ground truth, forecast, or long-term climatology
